title: Daily Meta funnel by market, 90 days
description: Spend, impressions, clicks, installs, trial starts and purchases per day for Taiwan and Hong Kong over the last 90 days in the funnel table.

args.query:
SELECT date, country AS market, ROUND(SUM(spend), 2) AS spend, SUM(impressions) AS impressions, SUM(clicks) AS clicks, SUM(installs) AS installs, SUM(checkouts_initiated) AS checkouts, SUM(trial_starts) AS trial_starts, SUM(initial_purchases) AS purchases, COUNT(DISTINCT ad_id) AS active_ads
FROM `speak-v2-2a1f1.analytics.meta_ads_creative_report_funnel`
WHERE country IN ('Taiwan', 'Hong Kong') AND spend > 0 AND date >= DATE_SUB((SELECT MAX(date) FROM `speak-v2-2a1f1.analytics.meta_ads_creative_report_funnel`), INTERVAL 90 DAY)
GROUP BY date, country
ORDER BY date, country
